mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PAYMENT_RECOVERY_TASK ( TARGET_TYPE, TARGET_TRX_NO, TARGET_ATTEMPT_SEQ, ORIGINAL_POS_TRX, ORIGINAL_ATTEMPT_SEQ, RECOVERY_STATUS ) VALUES ( #{candidate.targetType}, #{candidate.targetTrxNo}, #{candidate.targetAttemptSeq}, #{candidate.originalPosTrx}, #{candidate.originalAttemptSeq}, 'PENDING' ) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: WITH candidate AS ( SELECT ID FROM PAYMENT_RECOVERY_TASK WHERE ( RECOVERY_STATUS = 'PENDING' OR ( RECOVERY_STATUS = 'RETRY_WAIT' AND NEXT_RETRY_AT <= #{now} ) OR ( RECOVERY_STATUS = 'RUNNING' AND LEASE_EXPIRES_AT <= #{now} ) ) ORDER BY CREATED_AT, ID FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1 ) UPDATE PAYMENT_RECOVERY_TASK T SET RECOVERY_STATUS = 'RUNNING', CLAIM_TOKEN = #{claimToken}, LEASE_EXPIRES_AT = #{leaseExpiresAt}, NEXT_RETRY_AT = NULL, UPDATED_AT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM candidate C WHERE T.ID = C.ID RETURNING T.ID, T.TARGET_TYPE, T.TARGET_TRX_NO, T.TARGET_ATTEMPT_SEQ, T.ORIGINAL_POS_TRX, T.ORIGINAL_ATTEMPT_SEQ, T.RECOVERY_STATUS, T.RETRY_COUNT, T.NEXT_RETRY_AT, T.CLAIM_TOKEN, T.LEASE_EXPIRES_AT, T.CREATED_AT, T.UPDATED_AT
